scope: Black floating navigation with idle, hover, focus and touch states

checks.desktop: 1440x900: idle navigation hidden; hover expands island and reveals Work
checks.keyboard: Focus home -> Tab focuses Work -> Enter navigates to #work; keyboard capture saved
checks.touch: 320x740, touch emulation: links visible, no overflow, Work tap navigates #work
checks.quality: bun run check and bun run build pass
checks.console: No errors in final run; expected Motion reduced-motion warning

skills.karpathy-guidelines: Scoped header/CSS edits, no new dependencies
skills.ui-taste: Existing layout preserved, inspected desktop and touch captures
skills.antislop: Minimal collapsed wordmark, working destinations, no added decoration
skills.animation-performance: Bounded max-width transition confined to fixed island; opacity reveal; no per-frame React state; reduced-motion disables transition
skills.design-auditor: Source and browser review of responsive navigation, keyboard focus, semantics and touch targets
skills.playwright-cli: Actual CLI assertions and screenshots using installed Chromium

limitations: No physical-device frame timing or motion video analysis
External mail and resume destinations retained; not opened
